budget_items_kind_category.name: budget_items_kind_category
budget_items_kind_category.value:
("budget_items"."kind" = 'INCOME' and "budget_items"."category" in ('TICKETS', 'SPONSORSHIP', 'EXHIBITOR', 'GRANT', 'MERCHANDISE', 'OTHER'))
      or ("budget_items"."kind" = 'COST' and "budget_items"."category" in ('VENUE', 'PRODUCTION', 'CATERING', 'MARKETING', 'STAFF', 'SECURITY', 'LOGISTICS', 'ARTISTS_SPEAKERS', 'PERMITS_INSURANCE', 'LEAD_PROGRAM', 'OTHER'))
      or ("budget_items"."kind" = 'TICKET_ADJUSTMENT' and "budget_items"."category" in ('REFUND', 'DISCOUNT'))

budget_items_amounts.name: budget_items_amounts
budget_items_amounts.value:
("budget_items"."planned_kurus" is not null or "budget_items"."actual_kurus" is not null)
      and ("budget_items"."planned_kurus" is null or "budget_items"."planned_kurus" between 0 and 10000000000000)
      and ("budget_items"."actual_kurus" is null or "budget_items"."actual_kurus" between 0 and 10000000000000)

budget_items_cost_fields.name: budget_items_cost_fields
budget_items_cost_fields.value: "budget_items"."kind" = 'COST' or ("budget_items"."cost_behavior" is null and "budget_items"."supplier_local" is null and "budget_items"."funded_externally" is null)

event_analytics_vectors_impact_requires_.name: event_analytics_vectors_impact_requires_level
event_analytics_vectors_impact_requires_.value: "event_analytics_vectors"."net_economic_impact" is null or ("event_analytics_vectors"."impact_level" = 'economic_impact' and "event_analytics_vectors"."impact_methodology_version" is not null)

event_data_sources_sync_interval.name: event_data_sources_sync_interval
event_data_sources_sync_interval.value: "event_data_sources"."sync_interval_minutes" is null or "event_data_sources"."sync_interval_minutes" = 0 or "event_data_sources"."sync_interval_minutes" between 15 and 4320

event_datasets_json_arrays.name: event_datasets_json_arrays
event_datasets_json_arrays.value:
jsonb_typeof("event_datasets"."columns") = 'array' and jsonb_typeof("event_datasets"."rows") = 'array'
      and jsonb_typeof("event_datasets"."mapping") = 'array' and jsonb_typeof("event_datasets"."dropped_columns") = 'array'

event_impact_inputs_attribution_method.name: event_impact_inputs_attribution_method
event_impact_inputs_attribution_method.value: "event_impact_inputs"."attribution_method" in ('SURVEY_STRICT', 'RECORDED_DEADWEIGHT') and ("event_impact_inputs"."attribution_method" <> 'RECORDED_DEADWEIGHT' or "event_impact_inputs"."deadweight" is not null)

event_impact_inputs_deadweight_sourced.name: event_impact_inputs_deadweight_sourced
event_impact_inputs_deadweight_sourced.value: ("event_impact_inputs"."deadweight" is null) = ("event_impact_inputs"."deadweight_source" is null) and ("event_impact_inputs"."deadweight" is null or ("event_impact_inputs"."deadweight" >= 0 and "event_impact_inputs"."deadweight" <= 1 and length(trim("event_impact_inputs"."deadweight_source")) >= 10))

event_impact_inputs_displacement_sourced.name: event_impact_inputs_displacement_sourced
event_impact_inputs_displacement_sourced.value: ("event_impact_inputs"."displacement" is null) = ("event_impact_inputs"."displacement_source" is null) and ("event_impact_inputs"."displacement" is null or ("event_impact_inputs"."displacement" >= 0 and "event_impact_inputs"."displacement" <= 1 and length(trim("event_impact_inputs"."displacement_source")) >= 10))

event_impact_inputs_leakage_sourced.name: event_impact_inputs_leakage_sourced
event_impact_inputs_leakage_sourced.value: ("event_impact_inputs"."leakage" is null) = ("event_impact_inputs"."leakage_source" is null) and ("event_impact_inputs"."leakage" is null or ("event_impact_inputs"."leakage" >= 0 and "event_impact_inputs"."leakage" <= 1 and length(trim("event_impact_inputs"."leakage_source")) >= 10))

event_leads_amounts.name: event_leads_amounts
event_leads_amounts.value:
("event_leads"."opportunity_value_kurus" is null or "event_leads"."opportunity_value_kurus" between 0 and 10000000000000)
      and ("event_leads"."won_revenue_kurus" is null or "event_leads"."won_revenue_kurus" between 0 and 10000000000000)
      and ("event_leads"."booth_minutes" is null or "event_leads"."booth_minutes" between 0 and 1440)

event_sponsors_amounts.name: event_sponsors_amounts
event_sponsors_amounts.value:
("event_sponsors"."cost_kurus" is null or "event_sponsors"."cost_kurus" between 0 and 10000000000000)
      and ("event_sponsors"."attributed_value_kurus" is null or "event_sponsors"."attributed_value_kurus" between 0 and 10000000000000)
      and ("event_sponsors"."impressions" is null or "event_sponsors"."impressions" >= 0)

event_survey_links_routes_array.name: event_survey_links_routes_array
event_survey_links_routes_array.value: "event_survey_links"."routes" is null or (jsonb_typeof("event_survey_links"."routes") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("event_survey_links"."routes") between 1 and 12)

events_insert_own_org.name: events_insert_own_org
events_insert_own_org.withCheck: "events"."organization_id" = (select app.current_organization_id()) and (select app.current_user_role()) in ('owner', 'admin') and "events"."ai_config" is null and "events"."ai_config_version" is null and "events"."archived_at" is null

events_dates_ordered.name: events_dates_ordered
events_dates_ordered.value: "events"."end_date" is null or "events"."start_date" is null or "events"."end_date" >= "events"."start_date"

impact_calculation_runs_economic_only_wh.name: impact_calculation_runs_economic_only_when_reached
impact_calculation_runs_economic_only_wh.value:
case when "impact_calculation_runs"."achieved_level" = 'economic_impact'
        then "impact_calculation_runs"."total_output_impact" is not null and "impact_calculation_runs"."total_value_added" is not null and "impact_calculation_runs"."total_income" is not null
        else "impact_calculation_runs"."total_output_impact" is null and "impact_calculation_runs"."total_value_added" is null and "impact_calculation_runs"."total_income" is null and "impact_calculation_runs"."total_employment_fte" is null end

impact_calculation_runs_reached_needs_at.name: impact_calculation_runs_reached_needs_attendance
impact_calculation_runs_reached_needs_at.value: "impact_calculation_runs"."achieved_level" = 'insufficient_data' or ("impact_calculation_runs"."attendance_used" is not null and "impact_calculation_runs"."attendance_used" > 0 and "impact_calculation_runs"."attendance_basis" in ('CHECKIN', 'REGISTRATION', 'ORGANIZER_ESTIMATE'))

multipliers_non_negative.name: multipliers_non_negative
multipliers_non_negative.value: "multipliers"."output" >= 0 and "multipliers"."value_added" >= 0 and "multipliers"."income" >= 0 and ("multipliers"."employment_per_m_try" is null or "multipliers"."employment_per_m_try" >= 0)

survey_questions_choice_has_options.name: survey_questions_choice_has_options
survey_questions_choice_has_options.value: "survey_questions"."type"::text not in ('SINGLE_CHOICE', 'MULTI_CHOICE') or ("survey_questions"."options" is not null and jsonb_array_length("survey_questions"."options") >= 2)

survey_responses_exclusion_has_reason.name: survey_responses_exclusion_has_reason
survey_responses_exclusion_has_reason.value: "survey_responses"."is_excluded" = ("survey_responses"."exclusion_reason" is not null) and ("survey_responses"."exclusion_reason" is null or length(trim("survey_responses"."exclusion_reason")) > 0)

surveys_window_ordered.name: surveys_window_ordered
surveys_window_ordered.value: "surveys"."closes_at" is null or "surveys"."opens_at" is null or "surveys"."closes_at" > "surveys"."opens_at"
